title: Map of Highest Peak
goal: Assign maximum possible terrain heights with water at zero and neighboring differences at most one.
strategy: Every water cell constrains nearby heights. Multi-source breadth-first search computes distance to the nearest water, which is the greatest feasible height at each location.
